chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever purchases a sale-item, and three days pass without his coming, then there is no sale for him."

key_terms.بَيْعًا: a sale transaction or sold item
key_terms.فَلَا بَيْعَ لَهُ: then the sale is not valid for him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a buyer does not come to take possession after three days?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a sale in which the buyer does not come forward after purchasing. If three days pass without the buyer appearing, the sale is no longer upheld for him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3764 - Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from the Righteous Servant of Allah (swt) (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) who said:
"Whoever buys an item, and three days pass without him coming (to confirm or claim it), then the sale is void."
